name: My Petshop Simulator
summary:
Welcome to Paws & Whiskers, the pet shop that's all yours.

CARE FOR YOUR ANIMALS
Stroke kittens until the hearts fly, pick up puppies, wave a feather wand and throw the ball for a game of fetch. Tip food bags into bowls, fill the watering can at the tap and keep every pen clean. Happy pets sell for more.
